name: Sangarcía (Spain)
description: Square flag of three vertical stripes of red, white and blue, the white charged with a vase of lilies and a sword.
history: Sangarcía adopted its arms and flag officially on 14 April 1998, published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 10 May 2002; the flag is square, of proportion 1:1, tierced with red at the hoist and blue at the fly, the partition charged with a vase of lilies.

features.role: vase of lilies and sword on the white stripe
